nested.flatten:
#usda 1.0
(
    customLayerData = {
        dictionary inner = {
            asset deep = @<dir>/deep.png@
        }
        string notAsset = "./root.png"
        asset rootEmptyExpr = @`"${EMPTY}"`@
        asset rootExpr = @<dir>/root.png@
        asset[] rootList = [@<dir>/root.png@, @<dir>/textures/beside.png@]
        asset rootMissing = @<dir>/gone.png@
        asset rootSearch = @<dir>/textures/beside.png@
        asset rootSearchMissing = @textures/nowhere.png@
        asset rootTex = @<dir>/root.png@
    }
    defaultPrim = "World"
    expressionVariables = {
        string EMPTY = ""
        string NAME = "root"
    }
    upAxis = "Y"
)

def Xform "World" (
    customData = {
        asset cd = @<dir>/assets/cd.png@
        asset cdSearch = @<dir>/assets/maps/m.png@
    }
)
{
    asset absolute = @/elsewhere/abs.png@
    asset[] arr = [@<dir>/assets/tex.png@, @<dir>/assets/maps/m.png@, @maps/none.png@]
    asset beside = @<dir>/textures/beside.png@
    asset empty = @@
    asset fromSub = @<dir>/root.png@
    asset inAsset = @<dir>/assets/maps/m.png@
    asset nowhere = @textures/nowhere.png@
    asset own = @<dir>/root.png@
    asset rootOnly = @textures/beside.png@
    asset sampled.timeSamples = {
        1: @<dir>/assets/maps/m.png@,
        2: @<dir>/assets/tex.png@,
    }
    asset spelled = @<dir>/textures/beside.png@
    asset subBeside = @<dir>/sub/near.png@
    asset tex = @<dir>/assets/tex.png@

    def Xform "Nested"
    {
        asset atPackageRoot = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[tex/a.png]]@
        asset besideMember = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[sub/near.png]]@
        asset besideOuterPackage = @<dir>/nested/outside.png@
        asset innerRootBesideOuter = @<dir>/nested/near.png@
        asset innerRootOuterMember = @tex/o.png@
        asset innerRootOwn = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[own.png]]@
        asset innerRootSearch = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[tex/a.png]]@
        asset nowhere = @nowhere.png@
        asset outerBesidePackage = @<dir>/nested/near.png@
        asset outerInner = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[tex/a.png]]@
        asset outerMember = @tex/o.png@
        asset outerOwn = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[own.png]@
        asset outerSearch = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[tex/o.png]@
        asset own = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[sub/own.png]]@
        asset up = @<dir>/nested/outer.usdz[inner.usdz[tex/a.png]]@
    }
}
